entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Aulus Junius Rufinus (b. 115 CE, Rome) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Classical era, an age of empires, philosophical inquiry, and foundational civilizations, active in Rome.



Aulus Junius Rufinus was a key figure in the Roman administration, serving as a legate in Pannonia during the reign of Emperor Marcus Aurelius.



He played a crucial role in the governance of the Roman province of Pannonia, overseeing military campaigns and managing the province's economic and administrative affairs.



Rufinus' administrative experience and military leadership skills made him a prominent figure in the Roman imperial hierarchy, earning him recognition as a skilled and effective administrator.
